Hi there! I'm not a fan of lolicon and, in fact, I find it a little disturbing. Having said that, I'm not here to shit on your community or yell from the rafters about how vile it is. I'm here to offer a small tidbit of advice if you want to see this subverse last.

Personally, I've just blocked your subverse from appearing in my feed when I browse /v/all and I would encourage anyone who shares my view to do the same. So now I don't have to worry about the occasional bit of imagery like that showing up for me.

Now, for what it's worth, I think that what this subverse is about is teetering a really fine line between what is legally and morally acceptable but I also think that I would much rather all of you have a place where you can enjoy your hobby as long as you're not hurting anyone else. One way that you can do that is by changing the "Minimum CCP required to downvote in this sub" setting to a number higher than 0. Doing so automatically keeps any posts from this sub from showing up in /v/all and, let's face it, people who want to see this type of content are probably going to find their way here regardless.

This keeps you under the radar of most of the other site members and it also acts as a bit of good will towards the community as a whole. Both of those being things that I would think should go a long way in keeping this subverse alive and kicking for subscribers, like yourselves, who want to see it stay around.

Or maybe set a threshold that, once reached, you'll change that setting. For example once your subscriber count reaches 1000 people maybe it's a good idea to really consider making that change.

Not shitting on any of you or your hobby. I don't have any vested interest in seeing you stay or go. Voat is still very much in its infancy and we, as the Voat community, can choose to shape the etiquette and tone with which we go forward.

As a person who frequents and moderates other subverses that some find objectionable in content I'm working on ways that I can do the same as I'm advising you to consider. If you want to discuss it further I'm always happy to share my ideas. No worries if you aren't, though.

Cheers!
